mapper.select: SELECT id FROM agent_definition WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND UPPER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(configuration_json, '$.moduleType'))) = UPPER(#{moduleType}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT prompt_version.content FROM agent_definition JOIN prompt_version ON prompt_version.id = agent_definition.prompt_version_id WHERE agent_definition.id = #{id} AND agent_definition.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.sql: ad.id, ad.workspace_id, ad.code, ad.name, ad.description, ad.status, ad.default_connection_id, ad.default_model_profile_id, ad.prompt_version_id, ad.published_version_id, ad.version, ad.configuration_json, ad.created_at, ad.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_definition ad WHERE ad.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_definition SET default_connection_id = #{defaultConnectionId}, default_model_profile_id = #{defaultModelProfileId}, prompt_version_id = #{promptVersionId}, configuration_json = #{configurationJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE agent_definition ad JOIN agent_version av ON av.id = #{publishedVersionId} AND av.agent_definition_id = ad.id SET ad.status = 'ACTIVE', ad.published_version_id = #{publishedVersionId}, ad.default_connection_id = av.connection_id, ad.default_model_profile_id = av.model_profile_id, ad.prompt_version_id = av.prompt_version_id, ad.configuration_json = av.configuration_json, ad.version = ad.version + 1, ad.updated_at = #{now} WHERE ad.id = #{id} AND ad.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ad.version = #{expectedVersion}
